boundary_note: Bounded first pass for the three undrafted frozen records in the Maryland Campaign; MD003 Antietam keeps its existing draft unchanged. Preserve per-engagement dates: Harpers Ferry September 12–15, South Mountain September 14 and Shepherdstown September 19–20. The live NPS campaign heading does not replace any battle interval. Opening personnel and exact effective command boundaries remain unresolved. Draft claims do not alter model inputs.

claims.rationale: No inspected return establishes matched personnel at a common opening boundary. Imported numerical estimates remain unchanged; this pass does not validate them as simultaneous opening forces.

claims.value: The frozen force field says Corps; the live field reads zero. Palfrey gives 9,000 men at Harper's Ferry under Miles and 2,500 at Martinsburg under White, who retreated there; he says White surrendered 11,000 men. NPS says Miles surrendered a garrison of more than 12,000.
claims.rationale: The garrison changed as Martinsburg's troops arrived; the sources give different totals and scopes. No figure is adopted as a matched opening population, and surrender counts are not opening strengths.

open_questions: Returns, the surrender count and the effective Union command clock at the surrender remain deferred.

NPS/CWSAC is one family; Palfrey is one retrospective history by a former colonel of the 20th Massachusetts who says he drew on his own recollection and used advance sheets of the Official Records; his service in this campaign is not shown in the inspected text. Reports quoted inside Palfrey are not additional independently inspected families.
No automatic commander attribution, causal campaign score, morale/readiness number or battle/campaign double counting.
